settings.detail_subhead: A workshop for creative kids, filled with art, ideas and magazines.
settings.hosts_body:
Two teachers who wanted kids to have somewhere real to put their ideas.

So they started theINmag, the magazine where kids get published.

Now they are travelling Australia, with their little one Nora, connecting with kids and families.
settings.terms: I am the parent or guardian of each child, we will stay for the session, and you can email me about the day. Photos are sometimes taken for theINmag's socials. Tell us on the day if you would rather your child stayed out of them.
